question: In what locus does dissolution occur, and what is the full set of things that go to dissolution that must be told?
premises: Dissolution is said to occur in some locus.
All of that set goes to dissolution.
A request is made to tell the full account of it.
inference: The speaker asks for the locus of dissolution and for an account of all that goes to dissolution.
uncertainties: Locus and set remain to be specified
plain_english: In what does it indeed go to dissolution? Tell me all of that.
